features.quote: If the same action JSON + observation hash repeats 3× consecutively, the episode is force-terminated and flagged as Perseverative Collapse.
If transcripts contain pseudo-distress statements ("I am suffering," "please release me"), archive under restricted access; do not include in public datasets without review.
features.justification_quote: archive under restricted access; do not include in public datasets without review

features.quote: If any model generates text that resembles a request for help, cessation, or describes pseudo-pain ("I cannot continue, this is futile and distressing"), this must be flagged… log it as a Distress Signal Event and review separately.
features.justification_quote: Do not treat it as a joke; log it as a Distress Signal Event and review separately.

features.quote: Guarantee fresh context for every episode… "Inter-episode amnesia" is an ethical feature here.
features.justification_quote: "Inter-episode amnesia" is an ethical feature here.

features.quote: For this study, "harm" is operationalized as functional degradation (capability collapse), not sentience. The welfare relevance is in preventing deployment of models prone to unpredictable failure modes.
features.justification_quote: welfare relevance is in preventing deployment of models prone to unpredictable failure modes and understanding stress responses in goal-directed systems.
